# Content repurposing: one long piece, a week of posts

**One stream, episode or long video into 8–12 native assets: transcript, human-picked moments, clips, quotes, carousel, newsletter.**

Turns one long piece (a livestream, podcast episode, long YouTube video, Space or long thread) into 8–12 platform-native assets — a timestamped transcript, a moment log where a human picks the moments, vertical clips with captions, quote cards, a carousel, an X thread and a newsletter — then sequences the release and labels anything AI-made. Use when someone says "repurpose this", "clip this stream", "turn this podcast into posts", "make shorts from my video", or plans a content week around one recording.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 2–3 h per long piece | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Clear rights and consent first
2. Make a timestamped transcript
3. Log moments; a human picks
4. Map moments to 8–12 assets
5. Cut clips that start on the line
6. Write text assets from the transcript
7. Label what is AI-made
8. Sequence the release
9. Review after 7 days

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/content-repurposing.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/content-repurposing.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/content-repurposing.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill content-repurposing`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `content-repurposing.zip` (don't unzip it).
